description: Log records are not generated and made available for continuous monitoring.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for disabled logging services, incomplete audit trails, insufficient log retention, lack of log aggregation mechanisms, missing security event logging, and failure to make logs accessible for monitoring and analysis.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
